notes.title: The Supercharged Update is live!
notes.content:
“Bugvasion TD was released back in February on Steam and while it was a cute looking game we had to realize that we’ve focused too much on the visuals and not enough on the actual gameplay experience. We’ve decided to put another 4 months full time development into the game and build upon the existing base. The update adds new gameplay mechanics that change the whole experience adding excitement, variety and a lot of much needed fun.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/3a7ad5c659a1e4eec3ee074bb8042521b9b1f855.jpg[/img]

[b]Here what’s new:[/b]

[b]The Supercharging mechanic[/b] makes using the special attacks a much more rewarding and strategic experience, you can now reload each attack up to 6 times. Chain together several attacks and bring devastation to the enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/8e505429b473d54bad3ede7e7f8e0a820a39f248.gif[/img]

[b]The Event System[/b] brings randomized waves with different features, you’ll never know what comes next, it can be helpful or it can put you in disadvantage, it all comes down to luck.

[b]The Reaction System [/b]is there to compliment you for doing stunts like killing a certain amount of enemies at once or using a supercharged special attack among many other things. The reaction can be a funny animation or a one liner from our heroes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/dc2d8289de81995e0e55fe1fc14c55719c419d91.jpg[/img]

[b]Now you can earn points, unlock badges and Steam Achievements. [/b]The new Bug Report Screen will tell you all you need to know about the match you’ve just played and you compete with others on who gets the highest score.

[b]The tutorial has been expanded, new music [/b]was added and several previous issues have been ironed out.

[b]Chinese language support [/b]was also added!

“We really think we’ve nailed the fun and rewarding experience this time and made Bugvasion TD a casual strategy game worth playing”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/6ec5429782de05df973426db7820f08125360e48.jpg[/img]

We are still planning to release a free DLC with new maps in the coming month among many other things.

The future of Bugvasion TD:
- free DLC with new levels, enemies and towers
- seasonal updates
- more languages
- porting to Linux, Mac OS and consoles

The new update adds new gameplay mechanics which basically makes Bugvasion TD a lot more fun and rewarding experience.

Cheers!
Demeter, Director

notes.title: The Supercharged update is due to release in early May!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Bugvasion TD was released on the 17th of February and while most reviewers liked the theme and visuals of the game, the gameplay itself was only mediocre. 

We had to re-think and re-evaluate our goals and the direction of the game. We knew that we have something appealing but not fun enough so we’ve decided to overhaul the gameplay and add a lot of new mechanics - basically build upon the foundation and make Bugvasion TD a game worth playing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/79333602eccce931d3005b1434a69604fb693608.gif[/img]

We call it “The Supercharged” update and it will bring a lot of new things to the table, here is a brief list of the additions you can expect:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/ffc8fcf8c5e20552f8e791a45506ca9d7551e210.png[/img]

[b]* Supercharging [/b]-  All the special attacks are going to be super-chargeable several times to make them a lot stronger and there will a ton of new animations complimenting this new gameplay mechanic
[b]* Complete score, combo and badge system[/b] - now you will be able to see statistics on your matches, earn badges and points
[b]* Events [/b]- On every level there will be special waves where the conditions of the game change, some will make it harder, some will make it easier to win and it’s completely random  which ones you activate
[b]* Reactions[/b] - The characters in the game will react to your actions with voice over or animation
[b]* New music[/b] - we have changed the score completely to compliment the new mechanics and visuals
[b]* Steam achievements[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/4757a62adc0813dc26401c6791d826472a4a834e.gif[/img]

On the top of these there will be a ton of other small additions, QOL changes and optimization.

We truly believe that this update will change the game and bring our players a new experience!

For the next few weeks - until the release of The Supercharged update - we won't be updating the current version of the game, however we will add a public experimental branch as soon as the update is in playable shape.

We will keep you posted on our progress!

Cheers,
Demeter / IR
Head of Development

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/b4f398b2a8dd2d918fe3b9ae3c2474db1d531473.gif[/img]

* Events - On every level there will be special waves where the conditions of the game change, some will make it harder, some will make it easier to win and it’s completely random which ones you activate
* Reactions - The characters in the game will react to your actions with voice over or animation
* New music - we have changed the score completely to compliment the new mechanics and visuals

notes.title: Update #9 Bugvasion TD hits 1.1!
notes.content:
[b]2021.03.31 - V1.1[/b]

It has been a little over a month since Bugvasion TD has been released and we’ve finally hit 1.1. In this week’s update you can find:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/62ab6a59506eadb4a66993c7d845be4741bc1c84.jpg[/img]

- Added basic tutorial to a few levels and level select menu. Only plays when the levels are played for the first time. 
- Level design and feature fixes - we’ve double checked every building placement, every static weapon, every pathway to make your gameplay smoother.
- Added new music tracks for the tactical view phase before the first wave
- Stomper lvl01 is now unlocked from the first level
- Loading time optimizations and minor bugfixes

We will keep providing our players with weekly updates but now we are focusing on 1.2, the “Supercharged Update” due to release in a month, containing new gameplay features, new music, events, achievements and heaps more new additions to Bugvasion TD.

We’ll keep you posted!

Cheers,
Demeter
Head of Development

notes.title: Update #8 New animations for towers
notes.content:
[b]2021.03.25 - V1.09[/b]

We are bringing you yet again a big list of changes and updates to make your gameplay experience more enjoyable:

[b]New animations and visual upgrades for towers. [/b]We have updated most of the towers with new animations or in some places a with a completely new design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/47b57d7982dfafd09c837fc5da542e6262617012.png[/img]

[b]Wave length and boss health indicators added to the top of the screen,[/b] now you can see exactly how long each wave is going to take and how much health the boss has left.

[b]The HUD can be turned on/off with the TAB key [/b]or using the on screen icon so you can see the whole screen uninterrupted.
[b]
The rechargeable towers can now be recharged any time. [/b]Until now the player had to wait for the towers (Magny, Poison Gas and Laser Guard) to completely run dry before recharging them, now it can be done any time. The price of the recharge depends on how much it has to be recharged.
[b]
Other changes:[/b]
- current level number and name now displayed in the pause menu
- player health loss visual indicators added
- “ghost icons” added
- minor bug fixes and optimization

Next week we are planning to update some level designs, work on the tutorial and do some more optimization so we can shorten the loading times. In the meantime we are also working on our major “Supercharged” update, it’s coming along really nicely.

We’ll keep you posted!

Cheers,
Demeter
Head of Development

notes.title: Update #7 Tactical View added
notes.content:
2021.03.18 - V1.075

A new feature has been added: the Tactical View lets you plan your defenses easier by showing you the enemy spawn points, their paths and movement directions. You can activate the Tactical View by pressing R or using the icon on the top of the screen in-between waves. Before the first wave the Tactical View activates automatically, after the first you have to turn it on if you want to use it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/bf8749e090f356d4aefc33c03a8157354eb0a1d2.jpg[/img]

Changelog:
* added tactical view - in between waves you can turn on the tactical view with the R key, it shows you the enemy spawn points and pathways
* the difficulty can now be changed even in an active save slot
* pop up question added when resetting a save game slot

We’ll keep you posted!

Cheers,
Demeter
Head of Development

notes.title: The next big update
notes.content:
[b]Bugvasion TD released a month ago![/b]

We are so proud that our first game, Bugvasion TD is out for a month on Steam now with only positive reviews. However the last month also made us realize that despite getting a lot of positive feedback on how the game looks the gameplay is not on par with the visuals - so we have been actively working on new gameplay mechanics, events and a lot of cool additions that will make the game much smoother and fun to play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/3da58fa78516c27131d9e98b7839c3eaf5da41ff.jpg[/img]

[b]What happened so far since the release:[/b]
We have been listening to our players, fixing, tweaking and adding new things. Here is a brief list:
- Added Russian, French and Hungarian localizations
- Added speed up button
- Quality of life changes
- Gameplay balancing fixes
- Lot of bug fixes and optimizations 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/eb8c0da8c42d385f8b415a7cd850a55c25a39eb6.jpg[/img]
Supercharging is a go!

[b]Our plans for the next major “Supercharged” update, coming in 6-8 weeks:[/b]
We are working on a major update that will add a lot of new things to Bugvasion TD, such as:
- Events - a new gameplay mechanic - certain waves will behave differently and the player will have to adapt their defense according to the situation
- Supercharging - a new gameplay mechanic - all the special attacks are going to be super-chargeable several times to make them a lot stronger
- Tactical view - added planning phase before every wave
- Visual upgrade of the towers
- New animations, updated cutscenes
- New music 
- Achievements 
- Post match screen with detailed stats
- Tutorial
- A lot more quality of life changes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401622/c9740ec33d71fc87dc558a797aab9211e0b0d0d2.png[/img]
Some of the redesigned towers.

[b]Porting:[/b]
We have pushed the Linux and MacOS ports back a couple of months so we can make the game better and more fun. We are also working on several console ports but those are also only going to happen once our “Supercharged” major update is released, so every player can get the best version of Bugvasion TD.

We still have a long way ahead of us but we are looking forward to every step.

[i]Cheers,
Demeter, Head of Development[/i]

notes.title: Bugvasion TD small update #3
notes.content:
[b]V 1.025 [/b]

The third update for Bugvasion TD is online, here is the changelog:
- full localization to Russian, French and Hungarian languages, the voice acting in the cutscenes is still in English, but the subtitles and all in-game texts have been translated
- modified options menu, language menu added
- modified HELP screen
- minimal cutscene updates
- buffed the damage on the following towers: Gas Spray Tower, Shock Tower, Poison Gas Tower, Magny Tower
- changed the star / health values, now you need:
* 1-2 health points to get 1 star / 1 tech point for completing a level
* 3-7 health points to get 2 stars / 2 tech points for completing a level
* 8-10 health points to get 3 stars / 4 tech points for completing a level
- lowered the health on some of the bosses

There might still be a few places with texts that are not translated, we are working on these, more localization updates are on the way, thank you for your patience.
We are working on a lot of quality of life changes as well for the next update.

We’ll keep you posted!

Cheers,
Demeter
Head of Development
